practice.title: Practice feedback
practice.subtitle: Live coaching based on your acoustic parameters
practice.scoreHint: Share of recent voiced frames that landed inside your target range

feedback.pitchIn: Pitch is holding steadily inside your target range — keep this placement.
feedback.pitchLow: Pitch is low: try raising larynx position slightly and glide upward slowly from a comfortable note.
feedback.pitchHigh: Pitch is high: relax the throat and let the sound settle back to a more comfortable place.
feedback.resonanceLow: Resonance sits low (chest-heavy). Bring the resonance forward — imagine the sound leaving from the front of the face.
feedback.resonanceHigh: Resonance is nicely forward — keep that focus in the front of the mouth.
feedback.intensityLow: Volume is low: support the sound with steadier breath so it carries further.
feedback.intensityHigh: Volume is high: no need to push — a steady medium volume gives you more control over timbre.
feedback.unvoiced: No stable voicing detected yet. Try sustaining “ah—” or “ee—”.
feedback.idle: Start the microphone or import an audio file to begin practicing.
